notes.title: Portal Walk Gameplay Stream
notes.content:
On this broadcast we are playing Portal Walk. Three worlds, innovations and bosses will be demonstrated in the broadcast!

Add the game to your Wishlist! Also, don't forget that you can download the Public Demo version for free.

Enjoy watching the stream!
